d:
A young girl survives.
A mysterious space "artifact" the size of a stadium has crashed into the Pacific Ocean, and the event has unleashed a force that causes all adults on the planet to degenerate and regress into mindless violence and lawlessness. A young girl we only know as Sweetheart finds herself in limbo as her mother and father descend into chaos and anarchy, their once-warm family dissolving into something much scarier.
